explanation.tr:
• Gerund (V-ing): özne olarak (Swimming is fun), edattan sonra (good at drawing), bazı fiillerden sonra: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, miss, practise, give up, can't stand
• to-infinitive: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, refuse, agree, manage, afford, learn, would like; amaç (I came to help); sıfattan sonra (easy to learn)
• Bare infinitive (to'suz): modallardan sonra (can go), let/make + nesne (Let me go.)
• İkisini de alan: like, love, hate, start, begin
• Anlam değiştiren: stop, remember, forget, try
  I remember locking the door. (kilitlediğimi hatırlıyorum) / Remember to lock the door. (kilitlemeyi unutma)
explanation.tk:
• Gerund (V-ing): eýe hökmünde (Swimming is fun), sözlemden soň (good at drawing), käbir işliklerden soň: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, miss, practise, give up, can't stand
• to-infinitive: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, refuse, agree, manage, afford, learn, would like; maksat (I came to help); sypatdan soň (easy to learn)
• Bare infinitive (to-suz): modal işliklerden soň (can go), let/make + doldurgyç (Let me go.)
• Ikisini hem alýan: like, love, hate, start, begin
• Manysy üýtgeýän: stop, remember, forget, try
  I remember locking the door. (gulplandygymy ýadymda) / Remember to lock the door. (gulplamagy unutma)
explanation.ru:
• Герундий (V-ing): как подлежащее (Swimming is fun), после предлогов (good at drawing), после глаголов: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, miss, practise, give up, can't stand
• to-инфинитив: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, refuse, agree, manage, afford, learn, would like; цель (I came to help); после прилагательных (easy to learn)
• Инфинитив без to: после модальных (can go), let/make + дополнение (Let me go.)
• И то, и другое: like, love, hate, start, begin
• Меняют смысл: stop, remember, forget, try
  I remember locking the door. (помню, что запер) / Remember to lock the door. (не забудь запереть)

explanation.tr:
Modal fiiller + yalın fiil; -s almazlar, soruda başa gelirler.
• can / could: yetenek, izin, rica → I can swim. Could you help me?
• must: güçlü zorunluluk (konuşanın fikri) → I must study.
• have to: dış zorunluluk → I have to wear a uniform.
• mustn't: yasak → You mustn't smoke here.
• don't have to: gerek yok → You don't have to come.
• should / ought to: tavsiye → You should rest.
• may / might: olasılık → It might rain.
• Geçmiş: could, had to; çıkarım: must be (kesin öyle), can't be (kesin değil)
  She must be tired. That can't be true.
explanation.tk:
Modal işlikler + esasy işlik; -s almaýarlar, soragda başa geçýärler.
• can / could: başarnyk, rugsat, haýyş → I can swim. Could you help me?
• must: güýçli hökmanylyk (gürleýäniň pikiri) → I must study.
• have to: daşky hökmanylyk → I have to wear a uniform.
• mustn't: gadagan → You mustn't smoke here.
• don't have to: gerek däl → You don't have to come.
• should / ought to: maslahat → You should rest.
• may / might: ähtimallyk → It might rain.
• Geçmiş: could, had to; netije çykarmak: must be (hökman şeýle), can't be (hökman beýle däl)
  She must be tired. That can't be true.
explanation.ru:
Модальные глаголы + глагол без to; не принимают -s, в вопросе ставятся в начало.
• can / could: умение, разрешение, просьба → I can swim. Could you help me?
• must: сильная необходимость (мнение говорящего) → I must study.
• have to: внешняя необходимость → I have to wear a uniform.
• mustn't: запрет → You mustn't smoke here.
• don't have to: не нужно → You don't have to come.
• should / ought to: совет → You should rest.
• may / might: вероятность → It might rain.
• Прошлое: could, had to; вывод: must be (наверняка), can't be (не может быть)
  She must be tired. That can't be true.

explanation.tr:
• Sayılabilen isimler: tekil/çoğul olur → a chair, two chairs
• Sayılamayan isimler: çoğul olmaz, a/an almaz → water, money, advice, information, furniture, news, luggage, bread
  some advice (✓), an advice (✗); The news is good. (tekil)
  Saymak için: a piece of advice, a loaf of bread, a bottle of water
• Çoğul kuralları: -s (cats), -es (boxes, watches), y → ies (cities), f/fe → ves (knife → knives, leaf → leaves)
• Düzensiz çoğullar: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, person → people
• Her zaman çoğul: jeans, trousers, glasses, scissors
explanation.tk:
• Sanalýan atlar: birlik/köplük bolýar → a chair, two chairs
• Sanalmaýan atlar: köplük bolmaýar, a/an almaýar → water, money, advice, information, furniture, news, luggage, bread
  some advice (✓), an advice (✗); The news is good. (birlik)
  Sanamak üçin: a piece of advice, a loaf of bread, a bottle of water
• Köplük düzgünleri: -s (cats), -es (boxes, watches), y → ies (cities), f/fe → ves (knife → knives, leaf → leaves)
• Nädogry köplükler: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, person → people
• Elmydama köplük: jeans, trousers, glasses, scissors
explanation.ru:
• Исчисляемые: бывают в ед. и мн. ч. → a chair, two chairs
• Неисчисляемые: нет мн. ч., без a/an → water, money, advice, information, furniture, news, luggage, bread
  some advice (✓), an advice (✗); The news is good. (ед. ч.)
  Чтобы посчитать: a piece of advice, a loaf of bread, a bottle of water
• Множественное число: -s (cats), -es (boxes, watches), y → ies (cities), f/fe → ves (knife → knives, leaf → leaves)
• Неправильные: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, mouse → mice, person → people
• Всегда во мн. ч.: jeans, trousers, glasses, scissors
